$comment: Generated by orchestrator/backend/scripts/generate_agent_schemas.py from app.api.code_analysis.CodeFileClassification plus agent-side overlays where the CLI contract is intentionally stricter than the backend model.

file_id.title: File Id
file_id.description: Backend ID of the code_files record to classify.

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Security relevance tier. critical: parses untrusted input, auth, crypto, protocol state machines. high: memory mgmt, command building, file I/O. medium: utility, string handling. low: build, test infra. skip: generated, docs, vendored.

role.title: Role
role.description: Functional role of the file (for example, protocol_parser, auth_handler, crypto_impl, entry_point, memory_allocator, config_parser, utility, test, build, documentation).

slot_types.title: Slot Types
slot_types.description: Types of untrusted data that flow into this file. Required for critical and high files. Allowed values are the 8 public slot types; context-specific families like auth, crypto, and error handling are derived from role/language by the backend.

language.title: Language
language.description: Optional language correction when ingestion guessed wrong. Omit when the stored language is already correct.

analysis_priority.title: Analysis Priority
analysis_priority.description: Priority score combining classification tier, git churn, entry-point proximity, and past CVE history. critical: 80-100, high: 50-79, medium: 20-49, low: 5-19, skip: 0.

title: Code File Classification
description: Classification payload for bulk-classifying source code files by security relevance.
